question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**wastage**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wastage** means **loss by using it carelessly.** 

 
 
• **Example:** *The food **wastage** after the party was huge.* 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate answer is "wastage". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Extraction** - the act of pulling out quickly.

 
 
• **Example:** *The tooth **extraction** was over quickly.*
 
 
 
• **Greed **- selfish desire.
 
 
• **Example:** *Tom is always **greedy** for chocolates. *
 
 
 
• **Storage** - saving things for the future. 
 
 
• **Example:** *This food **storage** will help us ration food. *
